sentences.en: She thought she heard him grind his teeth and frowned.

sentences.en: They crush or grind the food, and are hence called " molars."

sentences.en: The Grind of the Navir ("Gate of the Giants") is a staircase carved by the waves out of the porphyry cliffs.

sentences.en: The island of Griend (or Grind) once boasted a walled town, which was destroyed by flood at the end of the 13th century.
sentences.vi: Hòn đảo Griend (hay Grind) từng là thị trấn có tường bao quanh, bị lũ lụt phá hủy vào cuối thế kỷ 13.

sentences.en: In this "mill," as he calls it, Erasmus continued to grind incessantly for eight years.

sentences.en: Bars of copper drawn over the bottom by mules or water-power (like the stone drags in the arrastra) grind off fine particles of copper, which hasten the reduction of the silver and diminish the formation of calomel.
sentences.vi: Các thanh đồng được kéo dưới đáy bằng con la hoặc sức nước (giống như đá kéo trong mảng) nghiền ra các hạt đồng mịn, giúp đẩy nhanh quá trình khử bạc và giảm sự hình thành calomel.

sentences.en: You can use a medium or a fine grind for this.

sentences.en: It took a long time to grind enough flour to make bread.

sentences.en: Use a coffee grinder to grind the star anise to a powder.
